risks.reasoning: For the three months ended March 31, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash flows used in operating activities of RMB1,917,448 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB3,854,385 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately RMB639,149 thousand and cash runway is approximately 6.03 months, below the 12-month medium threshold and at or above the 6-month high threshold.

The accountants' report shows profit for the year/period of RMB1,040,279 thousand, RMB1,518,855 thousand, RMB1,714,291 thousand, RMB287,433 thousand and RMB318,752 thousand for 2019, 2020, 2021, 3M2021 and 3M2022 respectively. There are zero comparable loss periods.

Revenue increased from RMB4,747,555 thousand in 3M2021 to RMB6,847,522 thousand in 3M2022, an increase of approximately 44.23%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

For 3M2022, the largest customer accounted for approximately 13.1% and the five largest customers accounted for approximately 19.4% of revenue. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%.

For 3M2022, the largest supplier accounted for approximately 31.8% and the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 36.7% of total purchases. The largest-supplier ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 30%, triggering a medium concentration risk.

The Pre-IPO Investors had been granted special rights including redemption rights. The formal disclosure states that, pursuant to the articles of association, a shareholders' resolution and each investor's confirmation, no such special rights will survive after the Listing and the redemption rights were terminated prior to submission of the listing application. No restoration mechanism is disclosed.

The formal legal section discloses the Bon Case, a litigation filed in December 2021 against the Group seeking invalidation of a transfer of a claimed 40% equity interest in Bon Property, which remained at a preliminary stage with trial not commenced as of the Latest Practicable Date. Although the Directors and litigation counsel assert the claim is groundless and will not have a material adverse impact, the pending court proceeding and its potential effect on acquired equity interests are not finally resolved, so the risk is left as needs_review.

The Group is an established property and facility management and AIoT solution service provider with substantial revenue from contracts with customers throughout the Track Record Period. Its core services are fully commercialized and revenue-generating.
